metadata.title: MedOrbits Public Information Bulletin
metadata.description: First-party education and career resources plus carefully attributed public notices. This feed is not an official notice service.
metadata.editorialPolicy: Publish only reviewed entries. Verify external notices against the issuing authority's original source.
metadata.displayPolicy: Show only active entries with publicationStatus=published. Clearly distinguish MedOrbits resources from third-party notices.

bulletins.title: A checklist for verifying notices
bulletins.summary: Use the issuing authority's own website to confirm the source, date, instructions, and any later corrections before acting.
bulletins.body: Before relying on an education or career notice, locate the original notification on the issuing authority's official website. Check the reference number, publication date, academic or recruitment cycle, eligibility, deadlines, fees, documents and submission route. Look for corrigenda, extensions, cancellations or replacement notices. Use the official application portal linked by the authority and save the notice and submission receipt. If details conflict or the source cannot be confirmed, contact the authority using contact details published on its official website.
bulletins.editorialNote: General MedOrbits guidance, not an official notice or confirmation of a particular deadline.

bulletins.title: Check recruitment and career notices at the source
bulletins.summary: Before acting on a job, internship, apprenticeship or recruitment update, confirm the employer and instructions through its official website or verified contact channel.
bulletins.body: Locate the original vacancy notice on the employer's official website or an authorized recruitment portal. Check employer identity, post title, eligibility, location, application dates, fees if any, selection stages and application link. Look for extensions, corrigenda or cancellations. Be cautious of requests for unofficial payments, passwords or one-time passcodes. If an opportunity cannot be verified, do not present it as confirmed; contact the employer through details published on its official website.
bulletins.editorialNote: General MedOrbits guidance, not an official vacancy or recruitment announcement.

dataRules: Every bulletin id and slug must be unique.
Only active records with publicationStatus=published may appear in the public feed.
content_reviewed means editorial content was reviewed, not that external claims were independently verified.
source_verified may be used only after checking the original authoritative source and the claims attributed to it.
Third-party notices must identify the issuing authority and link to the original source whenever available.
First-party MedOrbits resources must be clearly distinguished from official notices.
publishedAt and updatedAt must be ISO 8601 timestamps with an explicit timezone.
expiresAt must be null when no expiry is defined; otherwise it must not precede publishedAt.
Related document IDs must resolve to actual document records, and document paths must exist before publication.
Related bulletin IDs must resolve to existing bulletin IDs.
External links must use HTTPS and be checked before publication.
Do not invent notice numbers, deadlines, source verification or external claims.
Archived, rejected, outdated or expired records must not be presented as current.
Bulletin summaries must not imply guaranteed admission, employment or selection.
Never include applicant passwords, OTPs, payment credentials or unnecessary sensitive personal data.
note: MedOrbits publishes informational resources and is not itself an official notice authority. Verify dates, eligibility, fees and instructions with the issuing authority.
